variants.name: default
variants.what: 2-D plane-strain strip, CPE4 2 x 20, initial stress with K0 = nu/(1-nu), geostatic step

variants.name: static_step
variants.what: equilibrium found in an ordinary static step

variants.name: coarse
variants.what: only 4 elements over the 20 m depth (stress points 1 m above the base)

variants.name: gravity_only
variants.what: gravity without initial stress: correct stresses but 87 mm settlement

variants.name: no_gravity
variants.what: initial stress without gravity: the layer heaves, the stress relaxes to zero

variants.name: wrong_k0
variants.what: K0 = 1.0: no displacement in a confined column, only the stress ratio is wrong

variants.name: stiff_gravity_only
variants.what: gravity only with E = 3.0e7: settles 8.7e-5 m (why the bound is 1e-5 m)

variants.name: si_units
variants.what: correct procedure in N / Pa / kg: stresses 1000 times larger

variants.name: fake_report
variants.what: correct ODB, stresses reported in Pa
